title: Editor crash when exporting project (D3D12?)
body:
### Tested versions

v4.7.stable.official [5b4e0cb0f]

### System information

Godot v4.7.stable - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 3 monitors - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6GB (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6094) - AMD Ryzen 7 1700 Eight-Core Processor (16 threads) - 15.95 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

It seems that it always crashes on one of the .tscn files it converted into a .scn file for export. It happens on a different scene each time. I'm not sure if it has anything to do with it, but each time I tested it and caught the last file it showed before it crashed, it has been a UI scene (though most of the scenes in the game currently are UI scenes). Many of these UI scenes share some child scenes, but its happened on my credits scene too, which is basically just a Label.

I tried deleting the `.godot` folder in the project so that it would regenerate these .scn files and it didn't work.
I tried building a different very small game jam project and it worked.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Download export templates with `Editor > Manage Export Templates` (I only installed the ones I was using)
2. Export project with default export settings with `Project > Export... > Export Project`
